en: Neptune's largest moon and one of the most geologically active worlds in the solar system. Triton orbits Neptune backwards (retrograde) and at an extreme tilt — diagnostic of a captured Kuiper Belt object, making it likely a sibling of Pluto rather than a native Neptunian moon. Voyager 2 detected active nitrogen geysers venting dark organic dust 8 km into a tenuous nitrogen atmosphere; the southern hemisphere features 'cantaloupe terrain' — a network of dimples and ridges seen nowhere else in the solar system. Triton's retrograde orbit is decaying tidally; in roughly 3.6 Gyr it will either be torn into a Saturn-like ring or crash into Neptune.

en: Second-largest moon in the solar system and the only moon with a substantial atmosphere — thicker than Earth's. en: Tiny — just 504 km across — but the most reflective body in the solar system and one of the strongest candidates for present-day habitability beyond Earth. Cassini flew directly through plumes erupting from four 130-km-long fractures at the south pole; the spectrometer detected molecular hydrogen, organics including methane, salts, and silica nanograins indicating active hydrothermal chemistry on the ocean floor. The ocean is in direct contact with rocky seafloor — the same energy and chemistry conditions that gave rise to life at Earth's own deep-sea hydrothermal vents.

Cassini је прелетео управо кроз перјанице које избијају из четири раседа дугачка по 130 km на јужном полу; спектрометар је детектовао молекуларни водоник, органске материје укључујући метан, соли и наночестице силицијум-диоксида, што указује на активну хидротермалну хемију на дну океана. Океан је у директном додиру са стеновитим морским дном — под истим енергетским и хемијским условима који су довели до појаве живота у хидротермалним изворима на дну Земљиних дубоких мора.

en: Gargantua is the supermassive black hole at the heart of Interstellar (2014). Physicist Kip Thorne wrote the real general-relativity equations behind its image, so the film's glowing disk wrapping over and under the shadow is genuine gravitational lensing — the same physics this view ray-traces. The science even fed back into research papers.

Физичар Кип Торн написао је праве једначине опште теорије релативности на којима почива њен приказ, па је сјајни диск у филму, који се увија изнад и испод сенке, права гравитациона сочива — иста физика коју овај приказ прати методом праћења зрака. Та наука се чак вратила и у истраживачке радове.

en: The largest moon of Uranus and eighth-largest in the solar system. Voyager 2 imagery revealed a surface cut by enormous canyon systems — Messina Chasma alone stretches 1,500 km across the southern hemisphere — alongside large impact basins and the small fresh-looking Ursula crater. A 2017 stellar occultation tentatively detected a thin carbon-dioxide atmosphere, which would be the first atmosphere found on a Uranian moon.

en: Half Pluto's diameter — the largest moon-to-planet size ratio in the solar system. Charon and Pluto are mutually tidally locked, orbiting a common centre of mass about 980 km above Pluto's surface — effectively a binary planet system. New Horizons revealed a startlingly varied terrain: the smooth Vulcan Planitia plain to the south, an ancient cratered hemisphere to the north, and a dark red polar cap (Mordor Macula) of tholins formed when methane molecules escaping from Pluto's atmosphere collected on Charon and were processed by ultraviolet light. en: The boundary of the Moon's gravitational authority — roughly 60,000 km from the lunar centre. Inside this sphere, the Moon's gravity wins out over Earth's; outside, anything you leave behind drifts back toward Earth. Most stable lunar orbits live well inside, below 70% of the Hill radius, because mascon perturbation makes higher orbits unstable. The Hill sphere is also why the Moon has no natural moonlets — none can hold an orbit for long.

en: The mapping band — typically 150 to 500 km above the Martian surface. Six nations are flying spacecraft here right now.

en: The innermost and smallest of Uranus's five major moons — and visually the most extreme. The leading hypothesis is that Miranda was disrupted by an impact at least once, with the fragments reassembling under their own gravity. Verona Rupes drops ~20 km — under Miranda's low gravity, a falling object would take roughly 12 minutes to reach the bottom.

en: A ring of rocky leftovers between Mars and Jupiter — 2.2 to 3.2 AU. Hundreds of thousands of bodies catalogued; total estimated mass less than 4% of the Moon. Not the densely-packed asteroid field of science fiction: typical spacing between objects is about 1 million kilometres. The belt never accreted into a planet because Jupiter's gravity kept stirring the orbits, preventing collisions from sticking. Three Kirkwood gaps mark resonances with Jupiter where asteroids get cleared out.

То није густо збијено астероидно поље из научне фантастике: типично растојање између објеката износи око милион километара. en: Two-stage stainless-steel vehicle with a Super Heavy booster (33 Raptor engines) and a Starship upper stage (6 Raptors). Architected around orbital propellant transfer: a tanker variant refills Starship in LEO, enabling ~100 t to Mars surface — orders of magnitude more than any prior launcher. Orbital flight programme began 2023.
